verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes an actual llms.txt file at penpot.app/llms.txt (its content is directly quoted in penpot-docs-16 and penpot-docs-24, describing Penpot vs Figma and plugin ecosystem) plus dedicated agent-oriented docs pages (ai/mcp-server, ai/ai-workflows) explicitly designed for AI agents to consume. A probe of a different subdomain (help.penpot.app/llms.txt) returned 404, but that does not contradict the existence of the file on the main penpot.app domain that is directly cited. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that an agent successfully ingested/parsed the llms.txt file, and no evidence of an OpenAPI spec to complement agent-readable docs.
